channel.description: This is a randomly ordered feed of the most recent entries from SSbreakingHeadlines, skipping any feeds with errors.

item.title: Trump Warns Iran of 'Decapitation' After Ship Hit in Strait of Hormuz
item.description: Trump threatened Tehran with 'decapitation' on Monday after a cargo ship was struck by an unknown projectile in the Strait of Hormuz, authorities say.

item.title: FDNY reports 12 injured in Astor Place subway fire
item.description: NYC's emergency alert system warns of delays on Brooklyn-bound 4 and 6 trains.

item.title: Suspect named in Twin Falls In-N-Out shooting that killed 3, wounded 7
item.description: Police identified the suspect as 24-year-old Chad Williams, who died from a self-inflicted gunshot wound.

item.title: Pirro meets with Trump at White House amid speculation about her role
item.description: U.S. Attorney Jeanine Pirro met with President Trump at the White House on Monday afternoon, sources familiar with the matter said.
